scoring_justification: The Stoner factors are produced by a complex self-consistent vertex correction computation; a full recompute from intermediate susceptibility matrices is infeasible in the grader; result-level comparison with tolerances is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for the three Stoner factors
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Fig. 3(a) and text: alpha_max_s=0.97, alpha_0_c=0.97, alpha_Q_c=0.86 for parameters n=6.1, J/U=0.088, U=1.53 eV, g=0.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact numbers reported in the paper for the primary result; used as hidden gold.

outputs.description: The three Stoner factors (spin, ferro‑orbital, and antiferro‑orbital) obtained from the converged SC‑VC calculation.

output_contract.notes: All values are dimensionless. The checker compares each submitted value to the paper‑reported reference with an absolute tolerance of 0.02.
